doc.title: Jim Galloway interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998

title: Younger players who move him today
summary: He names Ray Anderson, Roy Hargrove and Kenny Barron as players with passion and knowledge of the roots.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

blocks.x: Who are the great ones today that have it?

Well that’s a hard one. Because you have to put different sort of parameters on the music. I mean it’s very difficult to put people in compartments I find, but the critics in particular were very fond of creating these categories that people would fit into. But jazz has become so multi-faceted now that it’s very difficult I think to define it, it’s impossible to define it. There are some of the younger players that move me, and Ray Anderson moved me, one of the younger trombone players, and knows the roots of the music.

He knows the roots of the music. He knows its origins. And he’s a very contemporary player, but to me he’s full of that passion and emotion and all the magic things. And Ray does it for me. And I’m sure I could think of a bunch more. Roy Hargrove is a really great young trumpet player, and again, he’s got this, it’s like a fanaticism, but playing, he’s got this huge passionate desire to play the horn. And I don’t want to idealize that sort of thing. I don’t mean to get over a message oh it’s so wonderful to be able to play and it’s — of course there’s many other aspects to it, and the business aspect being one of them. You have to be able to take care of business. But the musicians who can do that, or who have someone who can help, but also have this magic thing going for them, they’re the ones that do it for me. I could come up with a lot of — I mean on piano, I love Kenny
Barron’s playing and he has a sound, and the piano is an intimate sort of — but Kenny Barron. And it would take me a little time just to —
Sure, but there’s still some around that really do it for you.
Yeah, sure there are, of course there are.
